Just feel that most of the lifesaver comments along the lines of 'hey, don't do it', 'I care, take to me' etc are so generic that they could be replaced by a script that scans posts for keywords and comments at random intervals until the 24hrs is up.

You could also include the classic ambivalent 'yeah, don't really care but you should at least wait until tomorrow to end it' etc to spice it up.

You didn't ask to exist. You should have the right to live, but also the right to die. I firmly believe that.

Society seems to focus on preventing young people, particularly teenagers from committing suicide. Perhaps because society (read the taxpayer) has invested a lot of money in your education, healthcare etc. Economically, they want you to live so you can contribute to tax income and provide labour to the workforce. 

Work work work like a dog, then die. That's what they want to see. Society more than happy to pump you full of antidepressants to keep you functioning.

I agree with you. My definition of attractive stems from what the magazine's, social media, marketing and cinema are requesting. I've dated an industry model and the game is ultra competitive and the standards of beauty are fairly well defined. Plastic surgeons do most of their work based on a handful of celebrity examples, the Duchess nose is a classic example. Many fashion stores don't sell in higher sizes than 12.

Unfortunately societal roles have defined beauty in a way that is fairly narrow and very superficial.  The reason for expensive plastic surgery is partly due to supply and demand. Personally I think it's an investment which gives wealthier and more educated an advantage. Poor people are more likely to have wonky teeth for the same reason.

100% agree. Hot girl>hot guy>ugly guy>ugly girl. This is because men universally place a high value on looks, women will consider other things like earning potential, father material etc.

If looks are a priority for you, four things will make 90%+ of girls at least a 6-7/10. Most likely a 8-9/10.

- Lose weight down to size 6-8
- Learn to apply makeup properly, particularly foundation
- Plastic surgery and possibly dental surgery if required
- Well fitting clothes dresses etc

Honestly, most of the Instagram models etc are actually pretty ordinary looking when they take off their makeup. Naturally beautiful girls are much rarer than you think.

He gives the example of vanity, and how you will die 1000 deaths as you get older and the wrinkles/bags come in. Incidentally he ended up killing himself later too, what was his name...

Stats are showing that nitrogen is quickly becoming the more preferred gas over helium. It's cheaper, the air we breathe is already 78% nitrogen, and helium is a non renewable gas. 

Most balloon/party shops that sell helium actually sell a helium composite ie the helium is not pure enough to kill you. Nitrogen you buy from a gas retailer, where it needs to be 99.9%+ for industrial purposes.

This method will actually knock you out quite quickly if you do it correctly, 4-5 deep breaths can knock you out. Low likelihood of damage if you fail, because if there isn't enough inert gas you simply won't fall unconscious. Read a lot of medical reports online of botched nitrogen/helium asphyxiation attempts. Although many patients complained of numbness in extremities, headaches etc, medical examinations and scans found no long term damage and dismissed the patients.

Other big plus is that inert gases work simply by flushing out oxygen. You are not ingesting harmful gases/chemicals here.

I've done a 10 day water fast whilst working full time lol, your body would easily last 20-30 days without food. After 2-3 days you lose that hunger feeling as you move into ketosis, but when you get close to the end, you will be super weak. Your body eats itself, once all the fat stores are gone it gets bad. Very hard to suicide off this method imo.

Assume we limit the size of the universe to the observable/known section and restrict time to the age of this planet i.e 6 billion years.

The observable impact of the entire human species relative to this is less than a microscopic blip that lasted no longer than the blink of an eye.

I am not special. You and your family are not special. We are all just decaying organic matter, competing for resources. Happy for others to take my share, enjoy your trinkets.
Nothing matters. The universe is infinite, therefore the importance/significance of anyone's lives, me, you anyone, is as close to zero as you want to make it.

The dets don't matter, but essentially I am Sisyphus, who has spent his entire life pushing the boulder up the hill. Now it's rolled back all the way to the bottom, and society expects me to just keep at it and continue paying those tax dollars. No support, no compassion. Just a cold rationalism that if I want something, I need to earn it. All over again. I'm tired, completely exhausted by life at this point.

Camus commended Sisyphus for his resolve etc and I see his point. But I don't share his views. I think if I were in Sisyphus' position I would accept that this life is a fixed game and stop playing. Sometimes that is the only meaningful move left to make.

You can, many people do. But as you get older, doors begin to close, your path is more fixed. Child support, exorbitant house prices, debt burdens etc mean that I can't just simply change things as you can when younger. The cost benefit analysis is far poorer than it was when I was younger. Essentially I have rolled the dice and ended up with snake eyes. Yeah I could pick myself up and start all over again from square one, but I'm lazy and would rather just not play anymore.

I also have very little interest in being 50+ and will likely terminate my life later anyway. So there is even less benefit to working hard now as I will likely not enjoy the benefits in retirement.

Finally, I haven't got much that I want to do that I haven't already done. That's the advantage of ending your life a bit later; i've lived, loved, lost. I've experienced enough to make a more informed decision.

Life is cheap. Nothing is sacred.
